acquisition_method.evidence: Tandem mass spectra of top 12 most intense ions (excluding singly charged molecules) were collected with high-energy collision induced dissociation (HCD) fragmentation (2.0 m/z isolation width; 30% normalized collision energy; 17,500 resolution at 400 m/z).

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Cysteines were alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide (from a 500 mM stock solution) for 45 min at 25C.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Cysteines were alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide (from a 500 mM stock solution) for 45 min at 25C.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Samples were diluted 4 folds with 50 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0 and digested with Lys-C (Wako) at 1:50 enzyme‐to‐substrate ratio at 25 ºC for 2 h.
The same amount of sequencing-grade modified trypsin (Promega, Madison, WI) was added to the samples for 14 h incubation at 25 °C.

instrument.evidence: Peptides were dissolved in 3% acetonitrile, 0.1% formic acid and analyzed by LC-MS/MS using a nanoAquity UPLC® system (Waters) connected to a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
